info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector :Analyze Text API
Microsoft Azure Request Text Analysis Over A Collection Of Documents

items.docs: Submit a collection of text documents for analysis.  Specify a single unique task to be executed immediately.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Submit Text Analysis Job

items.docs: Submit a collection of text documents for analysis. Specify one or more unique tasks to be executed as a long-running operation.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Get Analysis Status And Results

items.docs: Get the status of an analysis job.  A job may consist of one or more tasks.  Once all tasks are succeeded, the job will transition to the succeeded state and results will be available for each task.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Cancel A Long Running Text Analysis Job

items.docs: Cancel a long-running Text Analysis job.
